rewards.redemption_notes: Unlimited Cashback Match: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

benefits.title: Unlimited Cashback Match
benefits.description: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

benefits.title: Refundable Deposit
benefits.description: Refundable deposits as low as $49 unlock credit lines starting at $200. Deposit amount will be $49, $99, or $200 based on creditworthiness.

benefits.title: No Credit Score Required to Apply
benefits.description: No credit score required to apply. We may use credit scores if available.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: You're never responsible for unauthorized purchases on your Discover Card.

benefits.title: Free Social Security Number Alerts
benefits.description: Get an alert if we find your Social Security number on the dark web. Sign up to activate this free benefit.

benefits.title: Freeze Your Account
benefits.description: If you misplace your card, you can prevent new purchases and cash advances in seconds with the on/off switch on our mobile app and website.

benefits.title: FICO Score and More
benefits.description: It's free and checking your score doesn't hurt your credit.

benefits.title: Real Human Customer Service 24/7
benefits.description: You can talk to a real human on our customer service team any time.

benefits.title: Tap to Pay
benefits.description: It's fast and easy to pay with your contactless Discover Card.

notes: Verified against official discover.com product page 2026-07-25. Rewards: 5% cash back on rotating quarterly bonus categories (activation required, up to a quarterly maximum) plus 1% on all other purchases. First-year Unlimited Cashback Match is a dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned (variable, not a fixed sign-up bonus) — captured in benefits and redemption_notes rather than signup_bonus. Annual fee $0. APR and FX fee not visible on the fetched page. Image URL cleared: prior asset was a Capital One CDN card-art file for the Discover it Cash Back (unsecured) product, not the Secured card.
